purpose: diagnostic corrected-combiner candidate; do not submit unless every registered local gate passes

source_predictors.model: frozen Track-A A1 physical-equal per-component predictions
source_predictors.definedness_masks: reports/track-a-family-ablation-masks.csv (A1_physical_equal baseline R/B/POI flags; F/Est union checked)

fixed_recipe.input_channel: existing finite frozen A1 gap-column predictions, each required in [0,1]; component values are held fixed
fixed_recipe.one_sided_gap_toy_formula: clip(1 - observed/expected, 0, 1); if a component is undefined emit placeholder 0 and omit it from every mean
fixed_recipe.poi: mean defined facility types for the facility half; equal-weight mean of the defined facility and establishment halves; undefined if neither half exists
fixed_recipe.top_level: equal arithmetic mean of defined transport, building, and POI predictions; undefined is excluded from the divisor; zero-defined rows are a hard failure
fixed_recipe.level: no Sca5/Dst5 additive region offset, normalization, rescaling, intercept, or leaderboard-derived value
fixed_recipe.component_weights: fixed A1 equal-vote-per-gap-idea weights, exactly as preregistered in config/track-a-preregistered.json

published_undefined_share_check.acceptance: candidate's hard component-definedness flags must put the share of rows with at least one undefined top-level component within 0.005 of each published whole-percent target; report any calibrated probability mean separately and never call it an observed binary-mask match

candidate_forecast.reason: no permitted per-tract target labels or holdout; corrected-combiner score metrics are diagnostic only

upload.authorized_by_steward: up to three corrected candidates may use 2026-10-29 spare slots only after local validation and pre-registration
